name: 1D_6_intersectionTarget
definition: Creates a 1D mesh (intersection target) for a voxel to ensure 6-connectivity for curve/line inputs. It produces 12 triangles (24 vertices if not shared, but defined as 12 triangles in the text, though the code creates a specific set). The text notes it produces 12 triangles and cannot be reduced further for this specific 6-connected result type.
summary: 1D_6_intersectionTarget is a diagonal mesh of 12 triangles that guarantees 6-connectivity for 1D inputs, distinguishing itself from cube outline targets by using internal diagonal intersections rather than voxel edges.
